features_verified: 1. PATCH /api/purchases/{id}/items/{index} - inline edit with revalidation and audit trail
3. Invoice Review Dialog opens when clicking view (eye icon) on a purchase
4. Validation summary banner shows correct counts (pass vs needs_review)
5. Flagged items show issue badges (Math Mismatch, Missing Name, etc.)
6. Problematic fields are highlighted in red
7. Fix button appears on flagged rows, pencil on clean rows
8. Clicking Fix focuses on the first problematic field (edit mode)
9. Saving an edit triggers revalidation and shows validation delta (Improved/Degraded)
10. Edit history panel shows all previous edits with changes, timestamps, user, delta
11. Validation filter dropdown (All Statuses / Needs Review / All Verified) filters the list
12. Totals update after editing an item
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH endpoint at /app/backend/routes/purchases.py:265 correctly implements inline edit with revalidation
Edit history stored via $push to edit_history array in MongoDB
Validation delta computed by comparing old_needs_review vs new_needs_review and error counts
InvoiceReviewDialog.js correctly implements inline editing with save/cancel buttons
classifyIssue() function maps validation errors to human-readable labels (Math Mismatch, Missing Name, etc.)
getProblematicFields() identifies which fields to highlight based on validation_errors
ExpensesPage.js validation filter correctly filters by review_status
seed_data_creation: Used existing 'Quick Review Test Vendor' purchase with 4 items (2 needing review) for testing
